Entry & Hallway Wall Art

The entry is the first thing anyone sees of your home, and a hallway is a long wall people walk past every day. These pieces suit a narrow wall, a console table or a long run.

Hanging tip. A tall, narrow piece suits the wall beside a door; a panorama or a row of pieces suits a long hallway. Press “See it in this room” on any piece below to hang it in the room above, at real size.
